All source#

Every Python file in the SDK, rendered with its docstrings. The reasoning lives in the code as much as in the prose.

tick/#

FileLinesWhat it is
tick/__init__.py74TICK SDK -- build a crypto arcade game for the handheld in one file.
tick/bets.py208One bet type, because there is only one bet.
tick/chain.py269The smallest chain client that can hold a player's money honestly.
tick/cli.py273tick -- start a game, watch the data, check the machine.
tick/display.py147One canvas, 480x320, landscape, whatever the panel underneath is doing.
tick/env.py79Settings, so a device can be configured without a shell.
tick/escrow.py349Real money, without asking the player to trust the handheld.
tick/feeds/__init__.py61Feeds: where the number comes from.
tick/feeds/base.py82What every feed is, and the two ways to read one.
tick/feeds/coinbase.py117Live trades from a public exchange, with no key and no account.
tick/feeds/replay.py138Record a market once, replay it forever.
tick/feeds/sim.py75A believable market with no network: the feed you develop against.
tick/feeds/substreams.py242On-chain prices: every swap in every watched ETH/USDC pool, block by block.
tick/game.py299What you write, and what you are handed.
tick/hud.py163A screen that already looks like the device, so your game can be one file.
tick/identity.py299Players have names, and the names carry their record.
tick/input.py258Four actions. That is the whole controller.
tick/market.py199The feed, plus everything a game needs to know about it before betting.
tick/money.py175Money, in integers, because floats lose it.
tick/pricing.py76Odds, from first principles, in about fifty lines.
tick/rounds.py148The clock that never stops.
tick/runtime.py248The loop you do not have to write.
tick/templates/game.py93GAME_TITLE -- a TICK game.
tick/testing.py168Play a thousand rounds in a second, with no window and no waiting.
tick/ticks.py70The one unit every layer above passes around: a price, stamped and numbered.
tick/ui.py273The look and the noise: a 480x320 pixel kit you do not have to design.
